Game Overview

In Bunny Jump Carrots, the core idea is straightforward: leap through vibrant levels as a daring bunny, snagging tasty carrots while dodging pesky foes and tricky obstacles. Test your reflexes in this fast-paced arcade adventure and aim for the highest score in a charming world full of challenges and surprises.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Bunny Jump Carrots is easy to pick up. Leap through vibrant levels as a daring bunny, snagging tasty carrots while dodging pesky foes and tricky obstacles.
